title: Common
description: Shared definitions for Penciled contracts v1. No root type; every other schema refers to these $defs. Strings that carry no screenshot content are restricted to token-shaped patterns so free text cannot slip into logs or metrics.

SchemaVersion.description: Contract version. Travels in both directions on /v1 (DESIGN 3.7). v1 is the CP0 freeze (2026-11-25).

IsoDateTime.description: RFC 3339 timestamp with offset or Z, e.g. 2026-11-18T21:04:11Z.

LocalDateOrDateTime.description: Wall-clock value without offset, as produced by AI-RESOLVE: YYYY-MM-DD (all-day) or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM[:SS]. The zone travels separately in `tz`.

VersionString.description: Dotted version such as an app version (0.3.1).

Token.description: Enum-like identifier with no free text (lower-case letters, digits, _ . : -). Used for ids, names and dims that must never carry content.

Source.description: How the screenshot entered the app (DESIGN 3.3 screenshot.source).

ActionKind.description: The two beta action kinds. No other kind exists in v1.

ScreenClass.description: Validated screen class returned by the server (DESIGN 5.4 ExtractResult.screen_class).

GateState.description: Card state after AI-CONF and the hard overrides (DESIGN 5.5, 3.8 pipeline states reachable from the server).

Flag.description: Per-field flag (DESIGN 5.4). Only needs_review and a missing required field set blocking.

NothingSubtype.description: Purchases extension (D24): subtype on nothing-to-do results.

DeadlineOrigin.description: Purchases extension (D24): set by code from the rules.json return-phrase pattern on the grounded evidence, never by the model.

GuardReason.description: Purchases extension (D24): id of the rules.json guard rule that blocked an item (first hit wins).

ChatVerdict.description: AI-CHAT heuristic output (DESIGN 5.1). chat_uncertain is treated as chat.

Tier.description: Pricing foundation (D25): server-controlled tier claim on the token record. Never read from the client.

Quota.description: Pricing foundation (D25): optional object in the extract response; older clients ignore it.

OcrLine.description: One OCR line: text and ML Kit confidence. Content; never log.
